sieve_global.description: If true, enables a global Sieve script for all users (not common, typically avoided)

sieve_global_script.description: Path to the global Sieve script (e.g., /etc/dovecot/sieve/global.sieve). Ignored unless sieve_global is true.

sieve_global_script_dir.description: Directory where global Sieve scripts are stored (used by some Sieve implementations for compiled scripts).

sieve_user_script.description: Location of per-user Sieve scripts. Common values: file:~/sieve, file:~/.dovecot.sieve, or dir:~/.dovecot.sieve.d/

sieve_user_script_dir.description: Directory where users can store multiple Sieve scripts (used with script name selection via active file)

sieve_before.description: Path to a global Sieve script that runs *before* user scripts (e.g., for spam filtering or logging)

sieve_after.description: Path to a global Sieve script that runs *after* user scripts (e.g., for archiving or notifications)

sieve_max_script_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) of a single Sieve script. Prevents oversized or malicious scripts.

sieve_max_scripts.description: Maximum total number of Sieve scripts (global + personal) allowed per user.

sieve_max_personal_scripts.description: Maximum number of personal Sieve scripts (excluding global ones) a user may store.

sieve_extensions.description: List of Sieve extensions to enable. Omit extensions your site doesn’t need for security.

items.description: Name of a Sieve extension (e.g., 'fileinto' for moving messages, 'vacation' for auto-reply)

sieve_debug.description: Enable verbose debugging of Sieve script execution (only for troubleshooting — not for production)

sieve_storage.description: Storage backend used for Sieve scripts (usually 'maildir' or 'file'). 'maildir' stores scripts in Maildir++ hierarchy.

sieve_global_scripts_dir.description: (Deprecated) Legacy path to global Sieve scripts directory. Prefer sieve_global_script_dir in modern Dovecot.

sieve_include.description: Additional Sieve-related settings (key=value pairs) to include in the plugin block. Use for advanced tuning.

items.description: A single Sieve plugin setting in the form 'key = value'. Example: sieve_trace_dir = /var/log/dovecot/sieve-trace/
